SELECT FROM SANCTION S LEFT JOIN CMM_CODE C ON C.CMM_CD = S.SNC_TYPE_CD WHERE S.USR_SN = #{userSn} AND S.SNC_TYPE_CD = 'SNCC0003' AND S.SNC_START_DT <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (S.SNC_END_DT IS NULL OR S.SNC_END_DT > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY S.SNC_SN DESC FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SANCTION ( USR_SN, SNC_PROC_USR_SN, SNC_TYPE_CD, SNC_RSN_CN, SNC_START_DT, SNC_REQ_ID, SNC_REG_ID, SNC_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( #{userSn}, #{adminUserSn}, 'SNCC0003', #{reason}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{requestId}, #{actorId}, #{actorId} )

INSERT INTO SANCTION ( SNC_SRC_ABR_SN, USR_SN, SNC_PROC_USR_SN, SNC_TYPE_CD, SNC_RSN_CN, SNC_START_DT, SNC_END_DT, SNC_REQ_ID, SNC_REG_ID, SNC_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( #{sourceReportSn}, #{userSn}, #{processorUserSn}, 'SNCC0003', #{reason}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{endedAt}, #{restrictRequestId}, #{processorUserSn}, #{processorUserSn} )
mapper.update: UPDATE SANCTION SET SNC_END_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, SNC_REL_REQ_ID = #{releaseRequestId}, SNC_UPDT_ID = #{actorId}, SNC_UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE SNC_SN = #{sanctionSn} AND SNC_TYPE_CD = 'SNCC0003' AND SNC_START_DT <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (SNC_END_DT IS NULL OR SNC_END_DT > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

UPDATE SANCTION SET SNC_END_DT = CASE WHEN #{automatic} THEN SNC_END_DT ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END, SNC_REL_REQ_ID = #{releaseRequestId}, SNC_UPDT_ID = #{actorId}, SNC_UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE SNC_SN = #{sanctionSn} AND SNC_SRC_ABR_SN IS NOT NULL AND SNC_TYPE_CD = 'SNCC0003' AND SNC_END_DT IS NOT NULL AND SNC_REL_REQ_ID IS NULL AND ( (#{automatic} = TRUE AND SNC_END_DT <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) OR (#{automatic} = FALSE AND SNC_END_DT > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.select: SELECT SNC_SN FROM SANCTION WHERE SNC_SRC_ABR_SN IS NOT NULL AND SNC_TYPE_CD = 'SNCC0003' AND SNC_END_DT IS NOT NULL AND SNC_END_DT <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND SNC_REL_REQ_ID IS NULL ORDER BY SNC_END_DT, SNC_SN LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SANCTION WHERE USR_SN = #{userSn} AND SNC_TYPE_CD = 'SNCC0003' AND SNC_SN != #{excludeSanctionSn} AND SNC_START_DT <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (SNC_END_DT IS NULL OR SNC_END_DT > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
